verdict.rationale: Public patch and security-fix responsiveness is a fair question for an open-source inference engine, so the axis applies. The evidence only says pre-built binaries can be downloaded from a releases page. Nothing documents release cadence, changelogs, security advisories, or how fast critical bugs or vulnerabilities get fixed.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how quickly the project ships patches for critical bugs and security vulnerabilities based on its public release history
